# Sayod 111 Commercial Data Infrastructure

> Pure async HTTP/2 commercial intelligence APIs, Apify Actors, 11 n8n workflows, and a 10-tool Streamable HTTP MCP Gateway (v1.2.0).

## Core Endpoints
- Developer Portal: https://sayod111.github.io/
- Compliance: https://sayod111.github.io/compliance.html
- Short LLM index: https://sayod111.github.io/llms.txt
- Apify Store Profile: https://apify.com/sayod111
- Official MCP Registry (v1.2.0): https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.sayod111%2Fsayod111-intelligence-mcp/versions/1.2.0
- Live MCP Endpoint: https://sayod111-mcp-gateway.sayodyalawi.workers.dev/mcp
- Free n8n Templates (11 JSON Workflows): https://github.com/sayod111/sayod111-n8n-templates
